title: Notifications | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: Notifications
hero.lead: The bell in the top-right corner collects notices relevant to your account and assignments. Its number is the unread count; counts above 99 are displayed with a limit.

body:
Open and read the notification centre

  1. Select the bell in the top-right corner.
  2. The list groups entries under Today, Yesterday and Earlier.
  3. Unread entries have a coloured marker, dot and highlighted heading.
  4. Select an entry to open its title, type, complete text, date and time. This marks it as read.
  5. If the entry has a matching destination, the detail button opens the related area.

Mark all as read or clear the list

  • The double-check icon appears with unread entries and marks all as read.
  • The bin icon appears when entries exist and clears the notification list.
  • Individual entries become read by opening them; the centre has no action for deleting one entry.

Types of notices

Icon, colour and type label identify the source. Kaderblick supports, among others:

  • news and internal messages,
  • attendance, responses and offers to help another team,
  • surveys and available videos,
  • created, changed, cancelled or deleted appointments,
  • car pools, bookings, cancellations and deleted rides,
  • assigned penalties, feedback and system notices,
  • registration, assignment, demo and Supporter requests and their processing.

You only receive entries triggered for your account. Depending on the type, details can show sender, appointment, date, location, attendance status, category or a button for opening the request.

Configure notifications in your profile

Open My profile and the Notifications tab. For each offered category, separately choose email, push or both. The page also covers response and appointment reminders and their times.

Check push notifications

Under Profile → Settings, Kaderblick shows push support, browser permission and this device’s registration. Request permission, enable or disable push for the device and send a test. If the browser permission is blocked, allow it again in the browser’s website settings.

Connections to other areas

  • Message notices open Messages.
  • Appointment and attendance notices open the relevant calendar entry.
  • Survey, news, feedback and car-pool notices open their content when a destination is available.
